description: `pardner client show --project harbor-billing` (the project's visible name, as the story and catalog use it) returns NOT_FOUND "Project not found"; only the UUID from `client list` works.
expected: Accept the project name when unambiguous, or say where to find the ID.
suggested_fix: Resolve --project by name as well as ID; improve the error.

description: `presence.actors[]` has only actorId/state/focusTaskIds/sessions: no name, and offline Actors are simply absent. To answer "is Dev around?" the reader must join `actors[]` (displayName) with `presence.actors[]` by a 70-character ID and infer offline from absence.
expected: Each presence entry carries displayName/kind, and every Actor appears with state "offline" when it has no session.
suggested_fix: Include displayName and explicit offline entries in the CLI view (or add `client presence --project`).

description: `observedAt` is a monotonic process clock (e.g. 1067308.66), not a timestamp, and is `null` when the hub is unavailable; `ttlMs` values are fractional (31713.535…). Neither can be read as a time by a person or agent.
